en.headline: CHP records three new Legionnaires’ cases; EMSD flags three towers
en.dek: Health officials reported three community-acquired infections in a week to 5 September, while the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department found three cooling-tower samples above its action level in August.
body: The Centre for Health Protection of the Department of Health said that from 30 August to 5 September it recorded three community-acquired Legionnaires’ disease cases, involving two men and one woman aged 61 to 68, all with underlying illnesses. Two patients live in Kwai Tsing District and one in Tuen Mun District.

The centre said an initial investigation treated the three as sporadic cases with no established link to other confirmed infections. As of 5 September, 139 Legionnaires’ disease cases had been recorded this year, compared with 167 in 2025 and 135 in 2024.

Separately, the Electrical and Mechanical Services Department said it tested 113 water samples from cooling towers in 57 buildings during routine inspections in August. Three samples, from towers at 3 Po Tung Road in Sai Kung, Mei Choi House at Shek Kip Mei Estate and Kam Shan Building on Tai Wai Road in Sha Tin, reached or exceeded the upper threshold of 1,000 colony-forming units per millilitre.

The department issued nuisance notices requiring disinfection. It said the owners have completed that work. Officials reminded building owners to inspect, maintain and test cooling towers under the department’s code of practice, and noted that men, people over 50, smokers and those with weakened immunity are more susceptible to the disease.

zh.headline: 衞生防護中心一周錄三宗軍團菌病 機電署三冷卻塔超標
zh.dek: 衞生防護中心公布8月30日至9月5日錄得三宗社區感染軍團菌病；機電工程署八月例行抽檢發現三個冷卻塔水樣本達行動水平。
body: 衞生署衞生防護中心表示，8月30日至9月5日期間錄得三宗社區感染軍團菌病，患者為兩男一女，年齡介乎61至68歲，全部有長期病患。其中兩人居於葵青區，一人居於屯門區。
中心初步調查認為三宗屬散發個案，與本港其他確診個案未有流行病學關連。截至9月5日，本港今年累計139宗軍團菌病，2025年及2024年全年分別為167宗及135宗。
另外，機電工程署公布，八月例行巡查期間在57幢建築物的冷卻塔抽取113個水樣本化驗，其中三個樣本總軍團菌數量達或超過每毫升1,000菌落形成單位的上限。涉事冷卻塔位於西貢普通道3號、深水埕石硫尾邱美彩樓及沙田大圍道金山樓。
署方已根據《公眾衞生及市政條例》向有關冷卻塔擁有人發出妨擾事故通知，要求進行消毒，並表示有關消毒工作已經完成。當局提醒冷卻塔擁有人須按實務守則檢查、保養及定期檢測水質；男性、50歲以上人士、吸煙者及免疫力較低的人較易受感染。
